The '''Greater Zoun Archipelago''' was a chain of islands located on [[Thonner/Legends|the fourth planet]] in the [[Thonner system/Legends|Thonner system]]. The archipelago was surrounded by a saline-infused, [[Color/Legends|yellow]] sea. The islands were eventually overgrown with lichen introduced accidentally from [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]].
